# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in Providentia.

This repository is the public showcase of the template: README, screenshots, demo animation,
release notes and issue templates. **It does not contain the source code**, so pull requests are
not accepted here. The template itself is a free download on
[Polar](https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_qkpmJsVoK393Bp6lfOAEBDXz3r7wDIzUDs1wO2p31hb).

## How you can help

- **Report a bug**: open an issue with the *Bug report* template. Say which version you use (see
  `CHANGELOG.md` in the download), your browser and the steps to reproduce. Check first whether it
  also happens in the [live demo](https://demo.rr-dev.eu/providentia/overview).
- **Suggest a feature**: open an issue with the *Feature request* template and describe the problem
  it solves for your dashboard.
- **Security issues**: do not open a public issue, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **Other questions**: write to rrstudio.apps@gmail.com.
- **Support the project**: a star on this repository, a donation on
  [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/rrstudioapps) or paying what you want on Polar.

Fixes and accepted ideas are released on Polar and listed in [the releases](https://github.com/rrstudioapps/providentia/releases).

By taking part you agree to the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
